source_text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,
target_text: Paul, Isor laga itcha dwara Khrista Jisu laga ekjon apostle, aru Timothy amikhan laga bhai,

source_text: to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
target_text: pora Colossae nogor te thaka biswasi khan aru Khrista te biswasi bhai khan logot likhi ase. Apuni khan logote anugrah aru Baba Isor aru Probhu Jisu Khrista laga shanti thaki bole dibo.

source_text: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
target_text: Amikhan Isor ke dhanyavad di ase, Probhu Jisu Khrista laga Baba Isor, aru amikhan hodai apuni khan nimite prathana kori ase.

source_text: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love which you have toward all the saints,
target_text: Apuni khan Jisu Khrista te biswas kora amikhan huni loise aru Tai nimite alag rakhikena thaka manu khan nimite apuni khan laga morom thaka sob jani loise.

source_text: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News
target_text: Apuni logote etu morom ase kelemane sorgote apuni nimite asha rakhi kene ase,

source_text: which has come to you, even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth,
target_text: kun to apuni khan logote ahise. Etu susamachar pora bisi phul ulaikene prithibi te aru bhi dangor hoi thaka nisena, apuni khan majote bhi etu kotha kaam kori ase, juntu din pora apuni khan hunise aru Isor laga anugrah laga kotha hosa te sikhise.

source_text: even as you learned from Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on your behalf,
target_text: Etu susamachar kotha apuni khan Epaphras pora sikhi bole parise, morom laga noukar, amikhan laga bodli te Khrista laga biswasi noukar.

source_text: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.
target_text: Epaphras pora apuni khan Atma te morom thaka to amikhan ke janibole dise.

source_text: For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,
target_text: Etu morom thaka nimite, jitia pora etu hunise amikhan apuni khan nimite prathana kori bole rukhanai. Apuni khan ke Tai laga gyaan pora atma laga kotha khan bujhi bole paribole nimite mangi thakise.

source_text: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God,
target_text: Amikhan prathana kori ase apuni khan Probhu ke khushi kori kene bhal rasta te berai kene jabo aru sob kaam mon dikene kori thakibo. Amikhan prathana kori ase apuni khan sob phol ulabo aru Isor laga gyaan te aru bhi bisi dangor hoi thakibo.

source_text: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy,
target_text: Amikhan prathana kore apuni khan sob kaam khan kori bole nimite takot pabo Tai laga mohima aru takot pora aru sob kaam te nomro aru khushi pora cholai kene loijabo.

source_text: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light,
target_text: Amikhan prathana kori ase apuni khan Baba Isor ke dhanyavad dibo, kun pora apnikhan ke puhor laga pobitro manu hoi kene Tai laga rajyote thaki bole nimite jaga dise.

source_text: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love,
target_text: Isor he amikhan ke andhera laga rajyo pora bachai loise Tai sob pora morom kora chokra laga rajyote ani loise,

source_text: in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins.
target_text: aru Tai pora he udhar pai, aru sob paap pora maph kori diye.

source_text: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.
target_text: Khrista to nadikha Isor laga protima ase, shristi majote prothom jonom luwa to ase.

source_text: For by him all things were created in the heavens and on the earth, visible things and invisible things, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers. All things have been created through him and for him.
target_text: Tai pora he sob jinis khan ke bonaise, sorgote aru prithibi te thaka, dikha aru nadikha jinis khan. Singhason aru rajyo cholawta aru sorkar khan aru adhikari khan, sob to Tai pora he bonaise aru Tai nimite he bonaise.

source_text: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.
target_text: Tai nijor sob jinis age te ase, aru Tai logote he sob jinis eke logote dhori kene ase.

source_text: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he might have the preeminence.
target_text: Khrista he gaw te matha ase, girja laga matha ase. Tai he shuru ase aru mora pora prothom jonom huwa ase, etu nimite Tai he sob jinis te age jagate ase.

source_text: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him,
target_text: Kelemane Tai logote Isor laga itcha bhorta thaka to Isor khushi paise,

source_text: and through him to reconcile all things to himself by him, whether things on the earth or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.
target_text: aru Putro te Tai nijor logote sob jinis ke milai loise. Tai Cross te bahai diya khun pora Isor shanti bonai dise. Tai dwara, Isor pora sob milai dise, etu prithibi aru sorgote thaka sob jinis ke.

source_text: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil deeds,
target_text: Ekta homoi te, apuni bhi Isor usorte alag manu thakise aru bhabona aru biya kaam pora Tai laga dushman thakise.

source_text: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,
target_text: Kintu etiya Tai nijor gaw te mora nimite apuni logote milai loise. Tai apnikhan ke Isor usorte pobitro aru sapha pora dibole nimite korise,

source_text: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which was proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I, Paul, was made a servant.
target_text: etu karone apuni biswas te thik choli kene, ki susamachar laga asha apnikhan pora hunise ta te nahili kene thik pora khara koribi. Etu susamachar ke sorgo nichete thaka sob manu logot prochar kori ase. Etu susamachar nimite moi, Paul, ekjon noukar hoi jaise.

source_text: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the assembly,
target_text: Etiya moi apuni khan karone dukh kori thaka nimite khushi pai ase, aru moi laga gaw mangso te ki komti ase aru Khrista pora dukh pa nisena etu Tai laga gaw nimite kori ase, kun to girja ase.

source_text: of which I was made a servant according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you to fulfill the word of God,
target_text: Moi etu girja laga ekjon noukar ase, Isor pora moike etu jimedari apuni khan uporte diya nisena, Isor laga kotha to pura kori bole nimite.

source_text: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,
target_text: Etu asurit kotha khan poila homoi pora manu khan nimite lukai kene rakhise. Kintu etiya kun Taike biswas kore taikhan ke dikhai dise.

source_text: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
target_text: Isor pora Tai laga sob mohima laga dhun juntu laga hosa lukai kene thakise, etiya to etu Porjati manu khan ke jonai dibole mon ase. Etu ase Khrista, jun apuni khan logote ase, mohima laga asha.

source_text: We proclaim him, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;
target_text: Etu Tai ase kun nimite amikhan prochar kori ase. Amikhan sob manu ke koi ase, aru amikhan sob manu ke gyaan pora sikhai di ase, etu pora sob manu khan ke Khrista laga usorte pura kori kene loi anibole paribo.

source_text: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.
target_text: Etu nimite moi kaam kori ase aru Tai laga takot loi kene thaki ase juntu takot moi logote kaam kori ase.

source_text: For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
target_text: Moi kiman dukh korise apuni khan nimite etu janibole dibo karone mon ase, aru Laodicea sheher te thaka khan, aru kun manu etiya tak moi laga chehera dikha nai.

source_text: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,
target_text: Moi taikhan laga mon dangor kori dibole nimite kaam kore aru morom pora eke logote ani kene sob gyaan laga dhun pora bhorta kori dibole nimite, Isor laga hosa kotha lukai kene rakhi thaka khan bujhi bole nimite, juntu Khrista ase.

source_text: in whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.
target_text: Khrista logote he sob gyaan aru buddhi laga dhun khan lukai kene ase.

source_text: Now I say this that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.
target_text: Moi apuni khan ke etu koidi ase kun pora bhi phusla kotha kori kene apuni khan ke thogai nadibo nimite.

source_text: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet I am with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.
target_text: Moi apuni khan logote gaw pora nathakile bhi, moi apuni khan logote atma te ase. Moi apuni khan laga takot aru Khrista uporte biswas aru bhal kaam khan kori thaka saikene khushi kori ase.

source_text: As therefore you received Christ Jesus the Lord, walk in him,
target_text: Etu nimite, apuni Probhu Jisu Khrista ke luwa nisena, Tai logote bera bhi.

source_text: rooted and built up in him and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.
target_text: Gash laga shikor thaka nisena nijorke Tai logote bonai lobi, aru apuni ke sikhai diya nisena hodai biswas te thakibi, aru dhanyavad di thakibi.

source_text: Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elemental spirits of the world, and not after Christ.
target_text: Sabi kun manu pora bhi apuni ke misa laga kotha khan koi kene dhori rakhibole nadibi, manu khan laga niyom hisab te, aru etu prithibi laga saman khan te khushi paikene, aru Khrista ke khushi nakori kene prithibi laga itcha te najabi.

source_text: For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily,
target_text: Kelemane Khrista pora he Isor laga ki itcha ase eitu khan pura manu khan logote thaki bole diye.

source_text: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power.
target_text: Apuni khan Tai logote bhorta hoi jaise, kun etu sob takot aru adhikar laga matha ase.

source_text: In him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ,
target_text: Tai pora apuni ke bhi sunnot kori dise aru gaw mangso laga sunnot nohoi kintu Jisu Khrista laga khun pora sunnot kori dise.

source_text: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.
target_text: Tai logote baptizma pora apuni ke kobor te dise, biswas aru Isor laga takot pora Tai apuni ke jinda kori dise, kun he Taike mora pora jinda kori dise.

source_text: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,
target_text: Jitia apuni khan paap aru gaw mangso laga sunnot pora mori kene thakise, Tai logote apuni khan ke jinda kori dise aru amikhan laga kiman paap thakise, etu sob maph kori dise.

source_text: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us. He has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.
target_text: Amikhan laga uporte baki lagai kene thaka khan sob Isor pora tirai dise, kun to amikhan uporte hali disele. Taike Cross te gojal mara pora etu baki hatai dise.

source_text: Having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
target_text: Khrista pora taikhan laga takot aru adhikar khan ke komjur koridi kene manu khan laga usorte dikhai dise, Cross uporte mori kene taikhan uporte jiti loise.

source_text: Let no one therefore judge you in eating or drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,
target_text: Etu nimite, apuni kha luwa kora to bisar kori bole nadibi, aru notun chand ula homoi te kha luwa kora khan manu ke bisar kori bole nadibi, aru Bisram din bhi bisar kori bole nadibi.

source_text: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ’s.
target_text: Eitu khan sob to ahibole thaka laga chaya nisina he ase, kintu asol laga kotha to Khrista he ase.

source_text: Let no one rob you of your prize by self-abasement and worshiping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
target_text: Kun manu dhorjo lobole mon ase aru sorgodoth khan ke aradhana kore, taikhan pora thogai kene tumikhan laga uphar harabo nadibi. Etu nisena manu to tai ki dikhise etu pora nijor mangso bhabona te bisi phutani hoijai.

source_text: and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments, grows with God’s growth.
target_text: Tai matha to dhori kene nathake. Etu matha pora he pura gaw laga kaam khan eke logote dhori kene rakhe; etu Isor pora diya pora he dangor hoi.

source_text: If you died with Christ from the elemental spirits of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,
target_text: Jodi apuni Khrista logote etu prithibi laga sob jinis khan chari dise, titia hoile aru bhi etu prithibi laga itcha te thaka nisena kele thaki ase:

source_text: “Don’t handle, nor taste, nor touch”
target_text: Apuni nadhuri bhi, aru khai nasabi, aru na chubi!”

source_text: (all of which perish with use), according to the precepts and doctrines of men?
target_text: Eitu khan sob to harai jai ase, manu khan pora kowa aru sikhai diya nisena.

source_text: These things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, humility, and severity to the body, but aren’t of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.
target_text: Eitu khan niyom to nijor laga gyaan pora bonai diya dhorom aru misa pora nomro dikhai diya he ase. Kintu taikhan laga gaw mangso laga kaam khan to eku daam nai.

source_text: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.
target_text: Jodi Isor pora apuni ke Khrista logote uthai dise, titia hoile apuni to upor laga jinis ke he bisaribi, kun jagate Khrista to Isor laga dyna hathte bohi ase.

source_text: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.
target_text: Prithibi laga jinis khan nohoi, kintu uporte thaka jinis khan ke bhabona koribi.

source_text: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
target_text: Kelemane apuni mori jaise, aru apuni laga jibon to Isor te Khrista dwara lukai kene ase.

source_text: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.
target_text: Jitia Khrista wapas ahibo, jun apuni laga jibon ase, titia apuni bhi Tai laga mohima te ahibo.

source_text: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry.
target_text: Etu nimite prithibi te thaka kaam khan sob morai dibi- bebichari, sapha nathaka, gaw mangso itcha, biya laga itcha, aru lalchi kora, kuntu to murti puja kora nisina he ase.

source_text: For these things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.
target_text: Etu kaam khan nimite Isor laga khong to ahi ase.

source_text: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them,
target_text: Ekta homoi te apuni khan etu kaam khan kori kene jinda thakise.

source_text: but now you must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.
target_text: Kintu etiya apuni khan sob purana kaam khan chari dibole lage- gusa, khong, biya bhabona, sorom khilai diya, aru apuni laga mukh pora biya kotha ula khan.

source_text: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,
target_text: Ekjon-ekjon logote misa kotha nokoribi, kelemane apuni khan logote purana manu aru purana kaam kori thaka khan sob ulaikene phelai dise,

source_text: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,
target_text: aru kun pora apuni khan ke notun manu bonai dise Tai laga gyaan pora notun hoi jaise.

source_text: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person; but Christ is all, and in all.
target_text: Yate kun bhi Yunani aru Yehudi nai, sunnot kora aru sunnot nakora nai, dusra jat aru desh laga manu nai, ta te Scythia laga manu nai, noukar aru ajad thaka manu nai, kintu Khrista he sob ase, aru sob te Tai he ase.

source_text: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;
target_text: Etu nimite, Isor pora basi luwa manu nisena, pobitro aru morom thaka khan, apnikhan daya, morom, nomro aru norom aru dhorjo eitu khan pindhi lobi.

source_text: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.
target_text: Ekjon-ekjon logote nomro aru morom kori kene thakibi. Jodi kunba manu dusra laga bhirodh kore, Probhu pora apuni ke maph kori diya nisena, taikhan ke bhi maph kori dibi.

source_text: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.
target_text: Etu sob kotha khan pora bhi, morom thakibi, etu pora he sob to bhal bonai dibo.

source_text: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.
target_text: Khrista laga shanti apuni khan laga monte raj kori bole dibi. Etu shanti nimite apuni khan ke ekta gaw hoi kene matise. Aru dhanyavad dibole janibi.

source_text: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.
target_text: Khrista laga kotha apuni khan logote bhorta hoi kene rakhi bhi. Atma laga gana kori kene ekjon-ekjon ke gyaan pora sikhai dibi. Apuni laga monte Isor ke dhanyavad dikene gana kori thakibi.

source_text: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
target_text: Apuni khan ki kore, kotha aru kaam pora, Probhu Jisu laga naam te he koribi. Tai nimite Baba Isor ke dhanyavad dibi.

source_text: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
target_text: Maiki khan, nijor mota logote bhal pora thakibi, etu he Probhu usorte thik ase.

source_text: Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.
target_text: Mota khan, nijor laga maiki ke morom koribi, aru taikhan logote mon tita kori kene nathakibi.

source_text: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.
target_text: Bacha khan, sob kotha te ama baba khan laga kotha mani kene thakibi, kelemane Probhu etu he khushi pai.

source_text: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.
target_text: Baba khan, apuni laga bacha khan ke biya kotha na koribi, etu pora taikhan laga mon dukh kori bole nadibi.

source_text: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.
target_text: Sewak kora khan, gaw pora ki pare etu loi kene apuni malik laga kotha mani kene thakibi, manu ki suku pora dikhi kene khushi pai etu pora nohoi, kintu bhal mon loi kene. Probhu ke bhoi koribi.

source_text: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,
target_text: Apuni ki kori ase, atma pora kaam koribi aru Probhu nimite koribi, manu khan nimite kora nisena na koribi.

source_text: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.
target_text: Apuni jane Probhu pora apuni waris hobole laga inam pabo. Etu Probhu Khrista ase kunke apuni khan sewa kori ase.

source_text: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.
target_text: Kun manu biya kaam khan kore tai biya kaam kora laga hisab te he sajai pabo, aru taike eku alag morom napabo.

source_text: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
target_text: Malik khan, ki bhal aru hosa ase etu he noukar khan ke dibi. Apuni bhi jane sorgote ekjon malik ase.

source_text: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving,
target_text: Prathana te mon dikena kori thakibi. Dhanyavad dikene hoshiar thakibi.

source_text: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds,
target_text: Mili kene amikhan nimite bhi prathana koribi, Tai laga kotha kobole nimite Isor pora dorja khuli dibole, Khrista laga hosa kotha khan kobole nimite. Etu nimite, moike bhi bandi kene ase.

source_text: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.
target_text: Prathana koribi moi apuni khan ke sapha pora koi dibole nimite, moi kobole thaka kotha khan.

source_text: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.
target_text: Bahar te thaka manu khan logote gyaan pora berabi, aru homoi to usor ase etu janibi.

source_text: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.
target_text: Apuni khan hodai morom pora he kotha koribi. Nimok hali kene mitha kori diya nisena hobole dibi, etu pora apuni khan manu logote ki kobole lage etu janibo.

source_text: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.
target_text: Moi sob kotha khan bhabi thaka to, Tychicus pora apuni khan ke jonai dibo. Tai ekjon morom laga bhai ase, aru ekta biswasi noukar, aru Probhu nimite kaam kora manu ase.

source_text: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,
target_text: Moi taikhan ke etu karone he pathaise, amikhan ki kori ase eitu khan janibole nimite, aru tai apuni khan laga mon to dangor kori dibole nimite.

source_text: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.
target_text: Moi taikhan ke Onesimus logote pathaise, ekta biswasi aru morom laga bhai, tai bhi apuni khan nisena he ase. Taikhan yate ki hoise etu sob apuni khan ke koi dibo.

source_text: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received instructions, “if he comes to you, receive him”),
target_text: Aristarchus, moi logote bondhi ghor te thaka ekjon sathi, apuni khan ke salam di ase, aru Mark bhi apuni khan ke salam di ase, Barnabas laga bhai (kun nimite apuni adesh paisele; jodi tai apuni khan logote ahe, taike bhal kori kene sabi),

source_text: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s Kingdom who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.
target_text: aru Jisu kunke Justus bhi mate. Taikhan to sunnot kori luwa biswasi jon khan ase aru ami logote Isor laga rajyo nimite kaam kori ase, aru taikhan pora moi laga mon ke aram di thake.

source_text: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
target_text: Epaphras apuni khan ke salam di ase. Tai bhi apuni khan nisena ekjon Jisu Khrista laga noukar ase. Apuni khan Isor laga itcha te bhal pora khara thaki bole nimite tai prathana koridi thake.

source_text: For I testify about him that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.
target_text: Kelemane moi tai laga gawahi di ase, tai apuni khan nimite mon dikene kaam kori ase, aru Laodicea aru Hierapolis sheher khan te thaka karone bhi.

source_text: Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you.
target_text: Luke, kun bemar bhal kora manu ase aru Demas, tai duijon pora apuni khan ke salam di ase.

source_text: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, with Nymphas and the assembly that is in his house.
target_text: Laodicea te bhai khan ke salam dibi, aru Nympha ke, aru tai laga ghor te thaka girja ke.

source_text: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans, and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.
target_text: Jitia etu chithi apuni khan majot porhe, Laodicea laga girja te bhi porhi kene hunai dibi, aru apuni khan bhi Laodicea pora patha chithi saikene porhibi.

source_text: Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”
target_text: Archippus ke kobi, “Probhu pora pa-a laga porisorja sai lobi, etu apuni pura kori bole lage.”

source_text: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you. Amen.
target_text: Etu salam moi nijor laga hath pora likhise- Paul. Moike luha pora bandhi kene thaka to yaad kori bhi. Isor laga anugraha apuni khan logote thaki bole dibo.

source_text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
target_text: Paul, aru Silvanus aru Timothy, Thessalonica sheher laga girja ke likhi ase, juntu Baba Isor aru Probhu Jisu Khrista te ase.

source_text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
target_text: Apnikhan logote amikhan laga Baba Isor laga anugrah aru Probhu Jisu Khrista laga shanti thakibi.

source_text: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each and every one of you toward one another abounds,
target_text: Amikhan hodai apnikhan nimite Isor ke dhanyavad dibo lage, bhai khan. Etu thik ase, kele koile apnikhan laga biswas bisi dangor hoi kene jai ase, aru apnikhan sob ekjon-ekjon nimite morom thaka to bisi hoi ase.

source_text: so that we ourselves boast about you in the assemblies of God for your perseverance and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which you endure.
target_text: Etu nimite amikhan nijor pura mon khushi kori kene apnikhan laga kotha Isor laga girja ke koidi ase. Apnikhan ke dukh kosto diya homoi te apnikhan kineka dhorjo korise aru biswas te thakibo parise etu laga kotha khan koidi ase. Apuni khan dukh kosto te dhorjo kora to amikhan koi thake.

source_text: This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of God’s Kingdom, for which you also suffer.
target_text: Etu Isor laga dharmikta pora kora bisar laga sakhi ase, kele koile etu nimite he apuni to Isor laga rajyo karone yogya ase, jun nimite apuni khan bhi dukh kosto pai ase.

source_text: For it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,
target_text: Kelemane, kun pora apnikhan ke dukh kosto diye, taikhan ke Isor pora he dukh kosto dibo, eneka kora to Isor nimite dharmikta dikha ase,

source_text: and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire,
target_text: aru jun khan amikhan logote dukh te ase, sob nimite aram pabo. Etu hobo jitia Probhu Jisu Tai laga mohan sorgodoth khan logote akas te ulaikena ahibo.

source_text: punishing those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,
target_text: Juli thaka jui pora Tai jun khan Isor ke najane aru Probhu Jisu laga susamachar ke mana nai taikhan uporte saja dibo.

source_text: who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,
target_text: Taikhan anonto homoi laga nosto te sajah pabo aru Isor aru Tai laga mohima thaka takot pora dur hoi jabo.

source_text: when he comes in that day to be glorified in his saints and to be admired among all those who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.
target_text: Tai eitu khan koribo jitia Tai laga pobitro khan logot stuti pabole wapas ahibo, aru Taike biswas kora khan Taike saikene asurit hobo. Kilekoile amikhan laga etu gawahi kora kotha ke apnikhan biswas korise.

source_text: To this end we also pray always for you that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire of goodness and work of faith with power,
target_text: Etu nimite amikhan hodai apnikhan karone prathana kori thake, amikhan laga Isor pora apnikhan ke mata to yogya hoi thaki bole. Amikhan etu he prathana kori ase Tai pora apnikhan laga bhal kaam laga itcha thaka sob pura kori dibo karone aru biswas laga kaam khan pura hokti pora hobole karone.

source_text: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
target_text: Amikhan laga Probhu Jisu laga mohima apnikhan laga jibon te dikhibo nimite prathana kore, aru Tai pora apnikhan ke stuti kori dibo, etu sob hobo amikhan Isor aru Probhu Jisu Khrista laga anugrah nimite.

source_text: Now, brothers, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to him, we ask you
target_text: Etiya bhai khan, Probhu Jisu Khrista wapas aha aru amikhan Taike lok kori bole joma kora laga kotha pora,

source_text: not to be quickly shaken in your mind or troubled, either by spirit or by word or by letter as if from us, saying that the day of Christ has already come.
target_text: apnikhan Probhu laga din asol pora ahi jaise bhabikena apnikhan mon ulta pulta nabhabi bhi, aru mon dukh nohoile manu laga kotha pora nohoile atma laga kotha nohoile amikhan laga chithi nimite apnikhan laga mon dukh na koribi.

source_text: Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction.
target_text: Kun manu pora bhi apnikhan ke thogabole nadibi. Kilekoile etu laga din nahibo, jitia tak niyom bhanga ekjon, kun nosto laga chokra ase, kun he Isor laga kotha ke ninda kore, tai ahi najai.

source_text: He opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God or that is worshiped, so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself up as God.
target_text: Etu tai he ase jun nijorke uthai diye aru Isor laga naam aru Isor ke aradhana kori bole thaka ki ase sobke bhirodh kore. Etu pora, tai Isor laga mondoli te jai kene ta te bohi jai aru nijorke Isor koi kene dikhai.

source_text: Don’t you remember that when I was still with you, I told you these things?
target_text: Apnikhan monte nai naki, jitia ami apuni khan logote thakise, etu homoi te etu kotha khan koi dise nohoi?

source_text: Now you know what is restraining him, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.
target_text: Taike ki pora rukhai ase apnikhan jani loise, aru taike thik homoi te he dikhai dibo.

source_text: For the mystery of lawlessness already works. Only there is one who restrains now, until he is taken out of the way.
target_text: Kilekoile bujhi bo napara laga niyom nathaka age pora kaam shuru hoise, khali ta te ekjon ase jun he taike etiya rukhai kene ase jitia tak taike rasta pora ulai nadiye.

source_text: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will kill with the breath of his mouth and destroy by the manifestation of his coming;
target_text: Titia niyom nathaka ekjon ke janai dibo, junke Probhu Jisu pora Tai laga saas pora morai dibo. Aru Probhu wapas ahibole laga din prokahit janai diya pora taike khotom kori dibo.

source_text: even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
target_text: Etu niyom nathaka ekjon aha to Saitan laga biya kaam pora he ase, aru tai pora kisim-kisim sakti pora chihna khan dikha bo, aru asurit kaam misa pora dikhai dibo,

source_text: and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
target_text: adharmikta laga misa pora he eitu khan sob koribo. Etu manu khan sob mori jai ase kele koile taikhan nijorke bachai lobo paribole thaka hosa laga morom to taikhan luwa nai.

source_text: Because of this, God sends them a powerful delusion, that they should believe a lie,
target_text: Etu karone Isor pora taikhan ke galti thaka laga kaam pathai dise, titia taikhan etu misa ke biswas koribo.

source_text: that they all might be judged who didn’t believe the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
target_text: Etu pora he taikhan sob uporte bisar anibo, jun khan hosa ke biswas kora nai, aru, ulta, adharmik kaam khan te khushi pai thakise.

source_text: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth,
target_text: Isor pora morom kora bhai khan, apnikhan nimite Isor ke hodai amikhan dhanyavad di thakibo lage. Kilekoile apuni khan ke Pobitro Atma pora sapha kori luwa aru hosa ke biswas kori luwa karone Isor apuni khan ke poritran dibole basi loise.

source_text: to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
target_text: Isor pora amikhan koi diya susamachar pora apuni khan ke mati loise, apuni khan Probhu Jisu Khrista laga mohima pabo nimite.

source_text: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word or by letter.
target_text: Etu nimite, bhai khan bhal pora khara thakibi, prochar kora aru amikhan laga chithi pora ki to sikhai dise, eitu khan bhal pora dhori kene thakibi.

source_text: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,
target_text: Etiya amikhan laga Probhu Jisu Khrista nijor, aru Isor amikhan laga Baba jun amikhan ke morom korise, aru Tai laga anugrah dwara amikhanke hodai thaka mon aram aru bhal asha dise,

source_text: comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.
target_text: etu pora apnikhan ke bhal kotha aru bhal kaam kori bole uthai thakibo dibi.

source_text: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified, even as also with you,
target_text: Aru bhai khan, amikhan nimite prathana koribi, titia Probhu laga kotha to sob jagate joldi punchibo aru Tai laga naam untcha hobo, jineka apnikhan logote hodai hoi ase.

source_text: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for not all have faith.
target_text: Biya aru paapi khan logot pora amikhan ke bachai loi lobole prathana kori dibi, kele koile biswas to sob logote nai.

source_text: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.
target_text: Kintu Probhu to hosa ase, Tai he apuni ke arubi khara kori dibo aru biya jon pora bachai lobo.

source_text: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.
target_text: Kintu amikhan Probhu dwara apnikhan uporte pura biswas ase, apnikhan juntu kaam kori ase etu hodai kori thakibo.

source_text: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and into the perseverance of Christ.
target_text: Aru Probhu he apuni laga mon to Isor laga morom aru Khrista laga dhorjo te apuni laga ke mon rakhi thakibo.

source_text: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks in rebellion and not after the tradition which they received from us.
target_text: Etiya bhai khan, Probhu Jisu Khrista laga naam te apnikhan ke hukum di ase, alsi thaka aru amikhan sikhai diya namani kene thaka khan pora dur thakibi.

source_text: For you know how you ought to imitate us. For we didn’t behave ourselves rebelliously among you,
target_text: Aru amikhan jani ase apnikhan bhi amikhan nisena koribo, kele koile jetia apnikhan majote amikhan thakise, etu homoi te amikhan alsi kora nai.

source_text: neither did we eat bread from anyone’s hand without paying for it, but in labor and travail worked night and day, that we might not burden any of you.
target_text: Amikhan kun laga bhi poisa nadikena bhat khai diya nai. Hoilebi amikhan din rath dukh paikene kaam korise, kele koile apnikhan uporte khang dibole itcha thaka nai.

source_text: This was not because we don’t have the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, that you should imitate us.
target_text: Amikhan logote adhikar nathaka karone nohoi, hoilebi nije he kaam kori kene apuni khan ke buja bole korise, eneka hoile apuni khan bhi amikhan nisena koribo.

source_text: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: “If anyone is not willing to work, don’t let him eat.”
target_text: Kilekoile apnikhan logote thaka somoite amikhan etu koise, “Kaam nakora manu khabo nalage.”

source_text: For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don’t work at all, but are busybodies.
target_text: Kilekoile amikhan huni ase ta te kunba apnikhan majote eku bhi kaam nakori kene, misa-misi kotha koi kene berai thake.

source_text: Now those who are that way, we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that they work with quietness and eat their own bread.
target_text: Etu manu khan ke Probhu Jisu Khrista laga naam pora amikhan utsah kori ase, nijor kaam kori kene khabi.

source_text: But you, brothers, don’t be weary in doing what is right.
target_text: Hoilebi, bhai khan, ki bhal kaam ase etu kori bole alsi nohobi.

source_text: If any man doesn’t obey our word in this letter, note that man and have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.
target_text: Kintu jodi kunba manu chithi te koi diya kotha khan namanile, taike bhal pora sai thakibi aru tai logote namilibi, titia tai sorom lagibo.

source_text: Don’t count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
target_text: Kintu taike dushman nisena nabhabi bhi, hoilebi ekjon bhai nisena samjhai dibi.

source_text: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.
target_text: Etiya, shanti laga Probhu Tai nije apuni khan ke shanti dibi sob homoi te. Probhu apnikhan sob logote thakibi.

source_text: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter. This is how I write.
target_text: Etu ami laga salam ase, moi Paul, moi nije hath pora likhi ase, juntu sob chithi te moi laga dagi dise. Eneka he moi likhe.

source_text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
target_text: Amikhan laga Probhu Jisu Khrista laga anugrah sob logote hodai thakibo dibi.
